Escape to Zanskar - Group Trip

Delhi — Manali — Sissu — Gonbo Rangjon — Phuktal Gompa — Jispa — Delhi

About This Trip

Embark on an extraordinary journey through the rugged and mystical landscapes of Zanskar. Starting with an overnight transit from Delhi to Manali, this expedition takes you past the iconic Atal Tunnel into the pristine valleys of Lahaul and Zanskar. Discover the awe-inspiring holy monolith of Gonbo Rangjon, trek to the cliffside Phuktal Gompa monk monastery, and stay in scenic high-altitude Himalayan halts like Sissu and Jispa. Perfect for adventure seekers looking to experience the raw, untouched beauty of Zanskar.

Itinerary

Board a premium overnight Volvo coach departing from Delhi in the late evening.

Arrive in Manali, check in to accommodations, and explore local sights & cafes. Briefing for the expedition.

Drive through Atal Tunnel, Sissu, and Darcha towards the majestic holy monolith of Gonbo Rangjon.

Day trek to the iconic cliffside Phuktal Monastery, then drive back towards Jispa.

Drive from Jispa back to Manali. Board the evening overnight Volvo coach to Delhi.

Early morning arrival in Delhi.
